comparison_notes.execution: Live published-wheel versus Manim CE comparison; both source-wheel builds unavailable because the shared environment killed the pinned asupersync dependency during compilation. Build workers are idle.
comparison_notes.sampling: One warmup each; three measured rounds. Driver reverses engine order on odd-indexed rounds. Optional cProfile runs follow all measured rounds.
comparison_notes.outputs: Original external adapted scenes and identical replacement WAV. CE frame count714; all FMN variants716. Baseline versus optimized raw video/PCM identity must also be checked separately.
comparison_notes.published_wheel: The published 0.5.0 wheel is intentionally not built locally; full package/module identity is recorded per engine.
comparison_notes.receipt_flags: Every FMN command adds --robot to retain the structured successful render receipt, exact FFmpeg argv and executable identity, and performance counters when supported. Original scene sources and audio are unchanged.
comparison_notes.output_flags: Published 0.5.0 uses --video_dir as an exact file; current source engines use --output as an exact file. Other scene, resolution, fps and thread arguments are preserved.
comparison_notes.timing_interpretation: Native stage timers measure owner-thread wall intervals. Encoder work overlaps rendering; output_finish includes drain, mux and publication. Whole-run child CPU and those stage intervals do not identify standalone encoder CPU.

tool_versions.scope: FFmpeg identity here describes the system validation/decoding tool and FMN encoder. CE uses its own installed encoding libraries; output metadata identifies Lavf63.1.102, versus Lavf60.16.100 for FMN. The recorded package closure includes av 19.0.1.

public_provenance.driver_identity_scope: Digest of the repository driver inspected while preparing this evidence; the raw run schema does not independently capture its digest at process launch.

review.scope: Live published FrankenManim 0.5.0 Python portal versus live Manim CE 0.21.0 on the original supplied external scenes and replacement audio. No pristine-source or optimized-source Python wheel is measured here.
review.timing: Sequential subprocess wall and child CPU measurements include interpreter startup through MP4 publication and process exit. One warmup per engine; three measured rounds with reversed engine order on alternating rounds. ffprobe and complete decoding occur after the render clock stops. No cProfile run is part of these means.
review.host_comparability: Shared, unisolated development worker. The configuration's idle-build statement refers to this investigation's build jobs; unrelated host load was not controlled. These timings are separate from the contributor machine and are not a performance gate.
review.streams: Every output has exactly one H.264 video and one 48 kHz stereo AAC audio stream, 640x360 picture, nominal 15/1 fps, and zero stream start times. CE has 714 decoded frames and FMN has 716. Complete decode succeeds for both.
comparison_limits: The reconstructed CE and FMN scenes have different typography, arithmetic boxing and frame rounding; they are comparable, not pixel-identical.

CE video duration is 47.599349 s and AAC duration is 47.040000 s. FMN video duration is 47.733333 s and AAC duration is 47.733000 s. The supplied replacement WAV is identical; the engines retain their own output timeline behavior.

Engine-specific encoding paths/defaults are retained. Container encoder tags are Lavf63.1.102 for CE and Lavf60.16.100 for FMN. This measures end-to-end engine behavior, not identical standalone encoder work.
Only three measured repetitions are available; shared-host variation is visible in the retained minima, maxima and individual observations.

Published-wheel native calls expose no separate rendering/conversion/encoder CPU attribution. Robot receipts preserve exact FFmpeg arguments and identity, but overlap prevents deriving encoder CPU from owner-thread wall intervals.
The separate native-audio optimization result does not establish the optimized Python portal speedup or satisfaction of existing performance gates.

publication_note.path_redaction: This portable evidence copy replaces machine-specific absolute paths and transient job identifiers with relative placeholders and omits host-specific environment metadata. The original measurement records and logs remain unchanged in the private working evidence.

path_conventions.comparison.json: The exact two-engine configuration appears in config; supply real local paths when reproducing.
path_conventions.env/wheel: Python environment containing the published versions and module digests retained in engines.
path_conventions.results/released-wheel-vs-ce: Run output root; warmup and measured directories retain their logical names.
path_conventions.native-job: Private FFmpeg scratch job for that specific render, identified here without process/session IDs.
path_conventions.ffmpeg: System FFmpeg executable identified by the retained version and robot receipt SHA-256.

publication_note.preserved: All render, probe, decode, validation and summary observations; warmup/sample plans; full public package versions; source/audio/module/artifact SHA-256 identities; command arguments; and successful FMN robot receipts are preserved. Commands have path substitutions and are not verbatim transcripts of private machine locations. Host kernel/CPU/load details and FFmpeg installation prefixes are omitted.
